mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", FIRST_RELEASE_DATE AS "firstReleaseDate", SCREENING_START_DATE AS "screeningStartDate", SCREENING_END_DATE AS "screeningEndDate" FROM MOVIE ORDER BY MOVIE_ID DESC

SELECT T.THEATER_ID, T.THEATER_NAME, T.LOCATION_CODE, L.CODE_NAME AS LOCATION_NAME, T.USE_YN, T.CONTEXT FROM T_THEATER T LEFT JOIN T_CODE L ON L.CODE = T.LOCATION_CODE AND L.GROUP_CODE = 'LOCATION' ORDER BY T.THEATER_ID
SELECT SCREEN_SEAT_ID, SEAT_NO, GRID_X, GRID_Y, SEAT_TYPE, USE_YN FROM T_SCREEN_SEAT WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY GRID_Y, GRID_X
SELECT GRID_X, GRID_Y, GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT FROM T_SCREEN_LAYOUT_OBJECT WHERE SCREEN_ID = #{screenId} AND OBJECT_TYPE = 'SCREEN' AND NAME = 'MAIN'
SELECT SCREEN_SEAT_ID FROM T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME_SEAT WHERE SHOWTIME_ID = #{showtimeId} AND BOOKER_USER_UID IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO S_BOOKING ( BOOKING_NO, USER_UID, SHOWTIME_ID, TICKET_COUNT, TOTAL_PRICE, STATUS, BOOKED_AT ) VALUES ( #{bookingNo}, /* 파라미터가 ID 문자열이든 숫자 UID든 상관없이 NUMBER타입 USER_UID로 변환 */ (SELECT USER_UID FROM USERS WHERE LOGIN_ID = TO_CHAR(#{userId}) OR TO_CHAR(USER_UID) = TO_CHAR(#{userId})), #{showtimeId}, #{ticketCount}, #{totalPrice}, 'CONFIRMED', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT B.BOOKING_ID, B.BOOKING_NO, B.USER_UID, B.TICKET_COUNT, B.TOTAL_PRICE, B.STATUS, TO_CHAR(B.BOOKED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS BOOKED_AT, M.TITLE AS MOVIE_TITLE, T.THEATER_NAME, L.CODE_NAME AS LOCATION_NAME, SC.NAME AS SCREEN_NAME, TO_CHAR(ST.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_AT, TO_CHAR(ST.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_AT, LISTAGG(SS.SEAT_NO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SS.SEAT_NO) AS SEAT_LIST FROM S_BOOKING B JOIN T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME ST ON ST.SHOWTIME_ID = B.SHOWTIME_ID JOIN MOVIE M ON M.MOVIE_ID = ST.MOVIE_ID JOIN T_THEATER T ON T.THEATER_ID = ST.THEATER_ID LEFT JOIN T_CODE L ON L.CODE = T.LOCATION_CODE AND L.GROUP_CODE = 'LOCATION' JOIN T_SCREEN SC ON SC.SCREEN_ID = ST.SCREEN_ID LEFT JOIN T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME_SEAT SS ON SS.BOOKING_ID = B.BOOKING_ID WHERE B.BOOKING_ID = #{bookingId} GROUP BY B.BOOKING_ID, B.BOOKING_NO, B.USER_UID, B.TICKET_COUNT, B.TOTAL_PRICE, B.STATUS, B.BOOKED_AT, M.TITLE, T.THEATER_NAME, L.CODE_NAME, SC.NAME, ST.START_AT, ST.END_AT

SELECT SEAT_NO AS "seatId", SEAT_NO AS "seatNumber", CASE WHEN BOOKER_USER_UID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "reservedYn" FROM T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME_SEAT WHERE SHOWTIME_ID = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY LENGTH(SEAT_NO) ASC, SEAT_NO ASC
